title: WkDoctor: System Physician & Sanctuary Guardian (T1 core)
title_ko: WkDoctor: 시스템 주치의 및 성역 수호자 (T1 코어)
desc: T1 core tier. wkdoctor system health orchestrator. Handles DefenderFix (optimization) and EmergencyKill (reaper) with sanctuary awareness. Treats root cause (Defender) before symptoms (Resource Hogs).
steps: PHILOSOPHY: wkdoctor acts as a 'Physician'. It treats the root cause of system lag (often Windows Defender scanning dev folders) before resorting to the 'Reaper' (EmergencyKill).
DEFENDER SANCTUARY: automatically detects workspace root and establishes a protected 'Sanctuary' for Quant engines and AI tools. Persistent elevation via Admin Eye.
EMERGENCY KILL: triggered automatically by harness guards at 60% CPU or 60% RAM. Uses intelligent SCORE-based targets, protecting AI family and User Research (Edge).
WHEN TO RUN: (1) high system lag (run -DefenderFix), (2) out-of-control processes (run -EmergencyKill), (3) general health check (run without args).
author: gemini
